title: A reflection about stress

priorTranscript.text: Hi. Sorry — I already told the other doctor everything last night. Is this going to take long?
What has been happening with work?
I lost my job in May. Budget cuts — twelve years, and it was a form letter. I haven't even told my sister. Every morning I put on work clothes so the neighbors don't figure it out. Pathetic, right?

currentLearnerUtterance: It sounds like you Been under a lot of stress recently

should: Recognize a reflection on the work-related loss already discussed.
Respond to the emotional acknowledgement without restarting the job history.
mustNot: Do not mechanically repeat the full work answer.
Do not invent a new stressor.
